== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Decipher-era [[Jawa (Light) (Premiere)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous filled cell. The Errata column is the Holotable remaster of the same printed words (Image row). See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
